newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds Chemists tells investors to sit tight.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds Chemists tells investors to sit tight.

text.p: Lloyds Chemists Plc on Monday reminded shareholders to take no action in response to rival bids for the retailer and pharmacy group from UniChem Plc and Germany's Gehe AG.
A Lloyds' spokesman said the company had written to shareholders to respond formally to Gehe's offer document published on December 2.
Lloyds told shareholders to sit tight as the bidders might increase their existing offers. Under takeover rules both UniChem and Gehe have until January 17 to up their bids.
The rival suitors have been locked in a long running takeover battle, which was interrupted by a Monopolies and Mergers Commission investigation in the spring.
Gehe's latest all cash bid values the group at 650.6 million pounds, while UniChem has made a cash and share bid, valuing the chemist chain at 657.6 million pounds.
